explanation: Sega wanted a fast, cool mascot to rival Nintendo's Mario. Sonic's speed was meant to show off its Mega Drive console, sold in North America as the Genesis.

claims.text: Sega created Sonic the Hedgehog, whose first game came out in 1991.
Nintendo, Sony and Atari did not create Sonic the Hedgehog.
Sega designed Sonic as a mascot to compete with Nintendo's Mario.
Sonic's speed was meant to show off Sega's Mega Drive console, sold in North America as the Genesis.
